summary: Command 8 validation (auth + per-user workspace + grounded copilot). Backend: 17/17 pytest tests pass covering register (201 + duplicate 409), login (200 + 401), /api/auth/me (with+without token), /api/workspace (401 anon, 404 pre-onboarding, 200 post), onboarding seeds only chosen frameworks (asserted CC6.1 absent for ISO+DPDPA), PATCH /controls/{id}/review flips status to operational and recomputes pulse, PATCH /risks/{id}/accept, copilot streaming references 'Zephyr' when Bearer token present, copilot anonymous still answers, plus regression on /health, /leads, /plans/preview. Frontend (1920x1080): /app without token shows auth-page; signup -> onboarding wizard (3 steps) -> platform-page-home with real greeting 'Good evening, NebulaCo76be' and live pulse (75). Controls page lists real workspace controls; opening DPDP-7 drawer and clicking drawer-mark-reviewed updates status to 'operational' and 'lastTested: Just now' (verified via /api/workspace). Copilot panel streams a grounded reply quoting the exact onboarded company name AND the actual frameworks + pulse score. Logout clears token and returns to auth-page. All critical Command 8 acceptance criteria met.

ui_bugs.issue: Still displays hardcoded 'Demo Organization' label and 'DU' avatar initials after logged-in user signs up with a different company; should show the onboarded company and user's initials.

issues: Framework chips lack an aria-pressed (or similar) accessible selection state — tests cannot determine which chips are preselected programmatically. Also default pre-selects ISO/IEC 27001 + SOC 2, which is correct UX but should be documented (clicking the ISO chip in that state toggles it OFF).

design_issues.screen: Platform console (any page while logged out loading)
issues: 4 noisy /api/auth/me 401 errors fire on initial /app load before AuthProvider decides to show auth-page. Suppress or guard the probe when no token is in localStorage.

action_items: LOW: Make Topbar org name + user avatar reflect WorkspaceContext.profile.company and AuthContext.user.name instead of static 'Demo Organization'/'DU'.
LOW: Add aria-pressed (or data-selected) to onboarding-fw-* chips for a11y + testability.
LOW: Short-circuit /api/auth/me probe when localStorage token is absent to silence console 401s on first paint.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to 685 lines mixing auth, workspace, copilot, plans, leads and admin — split into routers (auth.py, workspace.py, copilot.py) before adding more surface.
platform_auth.ACCESS_TTL_DAYS = 7 (long-lived access token, no refresh flow) is acceptable for the demo but should be shortened + rotated once production users exist.

Workspace mutations (/controls/{id}/review, /risks/{id}/accept) perform a full array rewrite with workspaces_col.update_one $set controls — for large workspaces consider $set on controls.$ with array filter.
No rate limiting on /api/auth/register or /api/auth/login — add a simple per-IP throttle before launch.
Pydantic email field uses plain str with manual '@' check — switch to EmailStr for proper RFC validation.

Onboarding falls back to ALL_FRAMEWORKS when the client sends unrecognised framework names (platform_auth-adjacent: workspace_seed.ALL_FRAMEWORKS logic). Silently defaulting could mask client bugs — consider 422 on empty/unknown framework input instead.
test_credentials: Self-signup; each test run registers a fresh ptest_<uuid>@example.com / pw123456. Demo account demo@dunzo.com / demo12345 untouched.
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_/ptest_ users + workspaces in Mongo (users_col, workspaces_col) and TEST_ copilot sessions. Safe to leave; prefix 'TEST_' / 'ptest_' is unambiguous for cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Command 8 is production-grade. Backend endpoints: register/login/me/workspace/onboarding/review/accept/copilot all stable. Frontend auth gate works, onboarding wizard works (default-selected frameworks on step 2 = ISO 27001 + SOC 2). Copilot panel fits inside 1920 viewport (right edge at x=1904) but renders very close to the edge — if viewport < 1900 the send button will clip. For future tests, send via Enter on [data-testid=copilot-input] to avoid click-outside-viewport flakiness. drawer-mark-reviewed button sits at the bottom of a long drawer — always scroll_into_view_if_needed before click. Workspace API verified via direct fetch inside page.evaluate for ground-truth assertions.
